title: A New Hope
crawl: It is a period of civil war. Rebel spaceships have won their first victory against the evil Galactic Empire. Two droids carrying stolen plans land on the desert world of Tatooine...

chapters.title: Escape from Tatooine
chapters.intro: The stolen Death Star plans must leave Tatooine. Protect Luke in the Jundland Wastes, find a pilot in Mos Eisley, and hold Docking Bay 94 until the Falcon is ready.

nodes.title: Tusken Raid
nodes.desc: Keep Luke alive for five rounds. He starts unconscious with one Shield. Use Krayt Call before a ready Tusken can attack. It returns that Tusken to hand and spends one action.

nodes.title: Jawa Sandcrawler
nodes.desc: The Jawas offer to join the expedition or trade spare parts before you return to the Lars homestead.

nodes.title: Dune Sea Detour
nodes.desc: Take a risky detour through Tusken territory. Win the battle to recruit a five-card Tusken party.

nodes.title: The Lars Homestead
nodes.desc: Luke finds the homestead destroyed. An Imperial patrol searching for the droids blocks the way to Mos Eisley.

nodes.title: Who Shot First?
nodes.desc: Han Solo and Greedo face off in the cantina. Keep Han alive through the shootout and defeat Greedo to recruit Han and Chewbacca.

nodes.title: Cantina Back Room
nodes.desc: Patch up and buy gear for the dash to the docking bay.

offers.label: Buy Hotshot DL-44 Blaster and Chewbacca’s Bowcaster
Buy Diplomatic Immunity and Death Star Plans

nodes.title: Mos Eisley Street Market
nodes.desc: A street vendor offers gear and cheap repairs before you make for Docking Bay 94.

offers.label: Hire a Crafty Smuggler and Contracted Hunter

nodes.title: Escape Through Mos Eisley
nodes.desc: Street thugs and Imperial patrols stand between you and Docking Bay 94.

nodes.title: Docking Bay 94
nodes.desc: Hold the line for eight full rounds. Imperial reinforcements arrive in rounds 2, 4, 6 and 8 while the Millennium Falcon prepares for lift-off.
nodes.ending: The Millennium Falcon lifts off from Docking Bay 94 with the crew and the Death Star plans aboard.

chapters.title: Death Star Rescue
chapters.intro: The Death Star captures the Millennium Falcon. Steal armor, find Leia, and get the crew back to the ship.

nodes.title: Steal the Stormtrooper Armor
nodes.desc: Ambush the boarding party in the Falcon’s rounded corridors and take their armor.

nodes.title: Imperial Armory
nodes.desc: The stolen armor gets you through the door. Stock up before proceeding.

nodes.title: Droid Reprocessing
nodes.desc: R2 slices the terminal and brings six labor and utility droids online.

nodes.title: ISB Interrogation Room
nodes.desc: Unlock the cells and turn five disillusioned Imperial personnel against the station.

nodes.title: Behind Enemy Lines
nodes.desc: Get past the Death Star’s security detail.

nodes.title: Tantive IV Prisoners
nodes.desc: Six survivors from the captured Tantive IV can reinforce the rescue.

nodes.title: Detention Block Outlaws
nodes.desc: Five prisoners will help you reach Leia if you open their cells.

nodes.title: Detention Block AA-23
nodes.desc: Defeat Lieutenant Childsen and free Leia before the guards seal the block.

nodes.title: Garbage Compactor 3263827
nodes.desc: Hold off the Stormtroopers until the Dianoga surfaces in round 3. Defeat it to escape.

nodes.title: Tractor Beam Controls
nodes.desc: Cover Ben while he disables the tractor beam.

nodes.title: Security Escape
nodes.desc: Cut through a security patrol on the way to the Falcon.

nodes.title: Blast Doors
nodes.desc: Break through one last security sweep before the hangar.

nodes.title: Service Alcove
nodes.desc: Repair and regroup before the last run to the Falcon.

nodes.title: Escape from Hangar Bay 327
nodes.desc: Protect the crew in the Hangar and keep Obi-Wan alive in the Duel Arena for eight rounds.
nodes.ending: Obi-Wan buys the crew the time they need. The Falcon clears the hangar with Leia and the stolen plans.

chapters.title: Battle of Yavin
chapters.intro: The Death Star approaches Yavin 4. Every pilot is needed for the trench run.

nodes.title: TIE Screen
nodes.desc: Waves of TIE fighters scramble to meet Red Squadron.

nodes.title: Surface Batteries
nodes.desc: Turbolaser towers fill the sky with fire.

nodes.title: Black Squadron
nodes.desc: Vader's wingmen are on your tail.

nodes.title: Yavin 4 Hangar
nodes.desc: Last checks before the final approach.

nodes.title: The Trench Run
nodes.desc: Space only. The Death Star's exhaust port is the enemy base. Vader and Tarkin stand in your way. Use the Force.

kyber_shard.name: Kyber Shard
kyber_shard.desc: +3 base HP for the rest of this chapter.

moisture_vaporator.name: Moisture Vaporator
moisture_vaporator.desc: Start each fight with 1 extra resource.

ben_s_lightsaber.name: Ben's Lightsaber
ben_s_lightsaber.desc: Your first unit each fight enters with an Experience token.

jawa_salvage.name: Jawa Salvage
jawa_salvage.desc: Draw 1 extra card in your opening hand.

detention_codes.name: Detention Codes
detention_codes.desc: Start each fight with the Plan token available.

targeting_computer.name: Targeting Computer
targeting_computer.desc: Start each fight with the Blast token available.
